newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Schroders Asia increases FRCD to HK$750 mln.
newsitem.headline: Schroders Asia increases FRCD to HK$750 mln.

text.p: Schroders Asia said its floating rate certificate of deposit has been increased to HK$750 million from HK$500 million due to overscription.

The facility has a final maturity of five years with a put or call option in years three and four. The issue was priced at par to float at 50 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 65 basis points.

Senior Managers, with HK$40 million each, are Asahi Finance Hong Kong, BA Asia, Bank Austria Aktiengesellschaft, BNP Hong Kong, Chase Manhattan Asia, CDFC, Commerz East Asia, Dah Sing Bank, Dresdner Bank Hong Kong, Fuji International Finance, Jardine Fleming, Ka Wah Bank, Royal Bank of Scotland, Sakura Finance Asia, Union Bank of HK, WestLB and Wing Lung Bank.

Managers, with HK$18 million each, are Agricultural Bank of China Hong Kong and China Construction Bank Hong Kong. Other managers, with HK$17 million each, are HongKong Chinese Bank and Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Hong Kong.
